revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 22.2% (200,966/164,501); growth fades toward maturity as the base gets larger.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin was 41.4% (83,276/200,966), FY2024 42.2%; set slightly lower for depreciation pressure from the capex ramp.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: not derived from filed data. This is a judgment about the effective rate. Reviewer should verify it against the 10-K tax note.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 was 9.3% (18,616/200,966), FY2024 9.4%; raised for the depreciation from heavy capex.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 was 34.7% (69,691/200,966), FY2024 22.6%; assumed to ease from the AI build-out peak.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta 1.15 (my assumption, not fetched) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~9.99% cost of equity. Debt is small relative to market cap (debt 58.7B), so WACC is about 10%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and roughly in line with long-run nominal GDP growth.

net_debt.source: financial_statements META derived.net_debt = debt 58,744 - cash 35,873 - marketable securities 45,719, 10-K 0001628280-26-003942
